12 weeks = 84 days.  
84 days + 4 days = 88 days.  
July 7, 1780 + 88 days: July has 31 days, so July 7 + 24 days = July 31, leaving 88 - 24 = 64 days more.  
August has 31 days → August 31 is 31 days after July 31, leaving 33 days → September 30 is 31 days after August 31, leaving 2 days → October 2, 1780.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1780-10-02
